s1.quote: ranging in depth from about 15 to 20 feet (4.5 to 6 meters), where a small tugboat wreck is located.

s2.quote: at a depth of around five meters, just a few meters from the coastline

summary.text: A small tugboat wreck resting upright in shallow water just off the Caracas Bay shore on Curacao. Easy to reach from the beach, popular with snorkelers and divers, and a good night-dive spot.
